provenance.paper_title: CausalNav: A Long-term Embodied Navigation System for Autonomous Mobile Robots in Dynamic Outdoor Scenarios

evidence.paraphrase: Embodied Graph constructed from map data and live perception, then updated in a temporal window. RAG retrieves from the Embodied Graph for semantic navigation and long-range planning under open-vocabulary queries.
During operation, CAUSALNAV applies fixed-rule insertion or replacement to multi-level semantic scene graph; the memory state changes while the governing update policy remains fixed.
During operation, CAUSALNAV applies fixed-rule correction of stored state to multi-level semantic scene graph; the memory state changes while the governing update policy remains fixed.

Graph is continuously updated within a temporal window to reflect environmental changes and dynamic objects. For CAUSALNAV, this specifically supports explicit deletion or eviction of stored items of multi-level semantic scene graph.

adjudication_notes: Strict-tier full-paper review (PDF p. 2): During inference, the operative memory component (multi-level semantic scene graph) changes through fixed-rule insertion or replacement, fixed-rule correction of stored state, explicit deletion or eviction of stored items; the governing policy remains fixed, and any learning reported by the paper occurs before deployment. Training-time learning, when present, was not counted as T3.
